purpose: Nested causal student for the real complement in Arm-C after fixed-t horizon residualization.

inputs.arm_bc_reference: OMITTED: RT-990.alt2.npy / RT-991.alt2.npy absent. Arm-B/Arm-C reference rows, Arm_C_vs_Arm_B, Student_raw_vs_Arm_B, the RT-990/RT-991 correlations and the oracle retention ratio are omitted rather than computed from canonical vectors, which would be fold-contaminated under this partition. The blend contrasts do not depend on them and are unaffected.

causality_contract.target: nested fold-pure Arm-C teacher residual; target is never a feature

gain_scope.note: The pre-break pair net is ~0 while the never-break pair net is positive: this is a never-break-cut gain, not a broad one. The damage-rate gate is applied to the dominant pre-break cut only; the whole-dev damage rate is reported here because it sits above the same numeric threshold and must not be read as gated.

rt1257_combo.note: Uses original dev OOF arrays RT-1254/RT-1255 from the CatBoost specialist research directory, not the deployment final10k artifacts.
rt1257_combo.endpoint_note: PRIMARY endpoint under PROTOCOL_CHAMPION_2026 is E2-E1 where E1 is RT1257_plus_seedclone -- RT-1257 with one matched exchangeable clone added, exactly one change from E0. all_clone_control is NOT an E1: it clones the CAT-300 and CAT-413 members as well as adding a clone, so it sits at RT-600 grade and a delta against it re-credits the two CatBoost slot swaps to the candidate. Reports before 2026-08-31 quoted that delta as if it were a champion-relative marginal; it is not. See research/scripts/armc_e2_e1_addition_contract.py.

oracle_retention.note: NOT a like-for-like ratio. The denominator is the oracle residual measured on the global (fold-contaminated) RT-991 over the dominant cell; the numerator is a nested fold-pure student trained on full-population residual labels. The two estimands differ, so this fraction is an order-of-magnitude indication only and must not be quoted as a retention rate.

verdict: PROMOTE for confirmation only: the nested 500-feature residual student beats the seed-clone blend marginally, has positive never-break pair net, and clears the pre-break damage gate. The light RT-1257 complementarity check is also positive: +student is +0.001285 mean whole-dev TS-AUC over the CatBoost hybrid.
